question: 综合 PTB-XL 和 Unified 多标签分类结果，论文用什么证据说明当数据规模增大时自监督预训练的重要性增加？
reference_answer: 在 PTB-XL 上，PatchECG 预训练模型（0.9385）与 supervised-only 模型（0.8889）的 AUROC 差异约为 5%；在 Unified 数据集上，所有模型 with and without pre-training 的 AUROC 差异为 4% 或更多，且 head-only fine-tuning 的预训练 PatchECG（0.9195）优于 supervised-only fine-tuning（0.8982）。
acceptable_answers: PTB-XL 上差异约 5%（0.9385 vs 0.8889）；Unified 上差异 4% 或更多，head-only 0.9195 > supervised-only 0.8982
预训练在 PTB-XL 上带来约 5% 提升，在 Unified 上所有模型有无预训练差异 ≥4%，head-only 预训练优于 supervised-only

evidence_refs.short_quote: The difference between the PatchECG model pre-trained on Ribeiro-B (0.9385), and the supervised-only model (0.8889) is much greater
From the results in Table 3 the difference in AUROC score between all models with and without pre-training was 4% or more
Notably, the results from head-only fine-tuning with the pre-trained PatchECG model (0.9195) are superior to supervised-only fine-tuning (0.8982)

reasons: Page 5 'The difference between the PatchECG model pre-trained on Ribeiro-B (0.9385), and the supervised-only model (0.8889) is much greater'（约 5%）支撑 PTB-XL 部分。

Page 6 'the difference in AUROC score between all models with and without pre-training was 4% or more' 与 'head-only fine-tuning with the pre-trained PatchECG model (0.9195) are superior to supervised-only fine-tuning (0.8982)' 支撑 Unified 部分。
三处数字与原文一致，数据集（PTB-XL/Unified）与指标（AUROC）对应正确；问题未写入答案数值。
